cells.quote: These studies usually focus on the differences in self-efficacy between mainstream and special school teachers (Catalano, 2018) and show the positive effect of training programs on competence development (Corona et al., 2017; Johnson et al., 2021).
cells.note: The study reports that differences were examined but does not state which teacher group had higher self-efficacy.

cells.quote: Two studies analyzed the current level of competence among teachers in their country of investigation, although the results differ once again. Ryan and Mathews (2022) reported a relatively high sense of self-efficacy among teachers in Ireland, whereas Wittwer et al. ( 2024) came to the opposite conclusion for German teachers.
cells.note: This is a cross-study comparison rather than a randomized comparison; the review reports conflicting country-specific findings and no printed effect size.
